newsitem.title: JAPAN: Toyota launches new compact car in Japan.
newsitem.headline: Toyota launches new compact car in Japan.

text.p: Toyota Motor Corp on Monday launched a new Corolla Spacio compact multi-purpose vehicle in Japan.
"We are setting a monthly sales target of 5,000 Spacios but expecting orders for 10,000 units in the first month," Toyota president Hiroshi Okuda told reporters.
Prices will start at 1.57 million yen, another official told Reuters, adding Toyota has no plans to export the car.
"I am sure we can sell 15,000 Spacios per month for the first six months. It has the potential for such volume," said Susumu Uchikawa, managing director domestic sales.
Toyota officials said the Spacio has no direct rival, but industry sources said the car was expected to compete with Mazda Motor's Demio and Daihatsu's Pyzar compact recreational vehicles.
Okuda said Toyota will introduce eight to 10 new models this year, including the Spacio, as well as partially remodelling five or six other cars.

Toyota's share of the domestic market fell to 39.1 percent in 1996, the first time it has been below 40 percent since 1982, and company officials said the introduction of the new models should help push Toyota's share back up over 40 percent.
